title: Ladder Stabilizer 2-Pack – The Ladder Stops Sliding Sideways
descriptionHtml:
The ladder leans against the facade – and keeps wanting to go sideways

You're halfway up with the gutter in one hand. The ladder rests against the plaster, and every time you reach to the side you feel it wanting to walk. On top of that you can't reach the eaves, because the ladder sits right where you need to work — and the top scuffs marks into the facade.

Wider contact, and distance to the wall

The stabilizers are screwed onto the top rung of the ladder and extend the contact in both directions, so that side forces are absorbed instead of turning into a walk. At the same time they hold the ladder out from the wall, so you have room for your hands at the eaves and gutter. The rubber rollers rest against the facade without leaving marks.

Features

  • The ladder doesn't walk when you reach to the side – the stabilizer extends the contact in both directions
  • You can reach the gutter and the eaves – the ladder is held out from the wall instead of being in the way
  • The plaster gets no scuff marks – rubber rollers against the facade, not a bare steel edge
  • Works against both wall and eaves – 2-in-1: the roller against the wall, the plate against the eaves
  • One pair per ladder – 2-pack that is fastened with U-bolts, stays on between jobs

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.

The scene images are AI-generated illustrations. The product photo shows the item as it is.
